native_checks_context: 198 current-version checks: 127 repeated affected regressions (27 general drawing and 100 two-point stair placement) plus 71 new stair sheet checks. Earlier 667-check suite was not rerun in full. Isolated native Qt scenes, actual bar paths, Undo/Redo, stale sources, manual additions/archives, IGZ reopening and untouched user geometry verified.

pdf_verification.visual_review: Front elevation Poppler rendering inspected in v15; all five pages independently measured; synthetic coordination fixture, not construction design

limitations: Selected editor modifies dimensions only; beam span and slab outline remain fixed; no multiple selection or endpoint/outline dragging
Existing cages require explicit Host review after concrete edits; no automatic bar regeneration
Analytical geometry only; no solver/materials/supports/releases/offsets/loads or torsional stiffness; solver_ready=false
Analytical conversion limited to 1000 Beam/Column members; interior crossings/near joints not automatically connected; node IDs change with coordinates
Fixed world-axis orientations: front -Y, side +X; one plan cut and one X section; floor-by-floor sets not implemented
Grid and levels are explicit user project coordinates, not inferred or checked against the building
Automatic dimensions are grid spacing and source model extents, including roof overhangs; member/opening dimensions remain manual
Vector rendering limited to 5000 source faces; technical rendering available for larger scopes, not benchmarked on whole Family10 in this release
Architectural/MEP generators and PDF/OCR remain unimplemented
Type library is local project/shared JSON; no bulk propagation; reinforcement recipes require explicit actual Host review

New viewport placement needs no Grid; legacy members hold Z fixed; horizontal beams/slabs, simple polygon without holes; advanced stairs use entrance midpoint and initial ascent with fixed or first-point Z
RC and mesh use simple polygons without openings; precast end dowels currently require a rectangular Host
Slab system designation and all reinforcement dimensions are explicit user input, not structural design
Mesh quantities are net wires; no mesh sheet count, overlaps, procurement waste, prestressing or physical plank subdivision
End dowels Straight / upward L only; no automatic support identification, anchorage or strength verification
Slab detail settings are per Host; slab recipe catalogue integration remains pending
All stair second points set ascent direction, not overall run or upper-floor Z; advanced stairs anchor at lower entrance midpoint and curve initial tangent

Explicit Stair/support geometric centreline clipping only: no automated support identification, bar extension, anchorage, cover, strength, headroom, railing or whole-building clash checks; designer input required
Advanced stair library uses a separate schema; no bulk propagation or click-to-fit dimensions; structural steel generator not implemented; new forms include full final tread at upper datum
Connection inspection compares longest continuous strict-interior model centreline against user input; surface length excluded; curved bars sampled, not analytic
Connection supports require closed non-intersecting two-manifold triangulations; overlapping shells and self-intersections unsupported; invalid meshes rejected without box fallback

Proposed uses saved Host/type settings; Actual requires valid cage; stale snapshots do not auto-refresh; limits 200 role bars, 5000 support triangles, 500000 triangle/path-point pairs and 500 project reports
User-defined reinforcement details are not strength design or certified standard compliance; existing 0.8.0 detailing limitations apply
Stair sheets use actual schema-2 Host and validated actual cage; model detail/review, not permit-ready certification or structural design.
Stair views use upright local axes, rigid yaw/translation only; multi-turn plan overlap may require manual per-level drawings; no automatic support/railing/headroom design.
Exact scales 1:20/25/50 reject paper overflow; 12000 triangles, 150000 bar path points, 120 marks, 200 sets. Spatial bars have projected views and actual BBS cut lengths.

Stair updates preserve untagged items and guides; changed pages with manual/generated edits are archived. Manual items retain paper positions and require explicit review after updates. Archives excluded from export.
Legacy general drawing sheets retain their existing workflow; new preservation/archive behavior applies to stair sheet sets.
publication_note: Line endings normalized to LF; original installed/native-tested hashes retained.
